headline: Oil Rises 1.42 Percent To $101.32 As Money Enters The Energy Pipe
narrative: Oil rose 1.42 percent to $101.32, with money entering the energy pipe. Gold fell 0.47 percent to $4,055.5 and silver fell 0.45 percent to $54.05, so the precious-metals pipe gave up ground as energy took the bid. Copper rose 0.31 percent to $6.64 and the S&P 500 rose 0.6 percent to 7,722.6, a smaller industrial and equity bid beside the oil move.
author: jordan
